submission_requirements.description: Workflow TD must complete all corrective tasks and submit conclusions in a controlled, auditable format before retry authorization

workflow_compatibility_assessment.description: Assessment of alternative checkpoint compatibility with current ComfyUI workflow architecture

required_content.character_director_recommendation_refere: string - reference to Character Director's checkpoint recommendation
required_content.checkpoint_tested: string - name of checkpoint tested for compatibility
required_content.test_results_summary: string - summary of compatibility testing results
required_content.checkpoint_path_verified: boolean - whether checkpoint path is accessible and valid

parameter_settings_revision.description: Review and revision of workflow parameters for identity strength and visual quality

required_content.revision_required: boolean - whether parameter changes are required

proposed_parameters.guidance_rationale: string - rationale for guidance scale change
proposed_parameters.reference_weight_rationale: string - rationale for reference weight change
proposed_parameters.steps_rationale: string - rationale for step count change

required_content.parameter_compatibility_notes: string - notes on parameter compatibility with recommended checkpoint

identity_preservation_evaluation.description: Evaluation of identity preservation components: IP-Adapter, LoRA, reference lock, and related mechanisms

ip_adapter_evaluation.configuration_recommendation: string - recommended IP-Adapter configuration if enabled

lora_evaluation.available_in_workflow: boolean - whether LoRA capability is available
lora_evaluation.lora_path: string - path to recommended LoRA if applicable

reference_lock_evaluation.currently_enabled: boolean - whether reference lock is currently active
reference_lock_evaluation.rationale: string - rationale for reference lock recommendation

required_content.combined_identity_strategy: string - overall identity preservation strategy combining all components
required_content.identity_strength_target: string - target identity preservation strength level
required_content.implementation_complexity: enum: [low, medium, high] - complexity of implementing recommendations

implementation_requirements.description: Complete workflow revision requirements before retry - the Workflow TD sign-off specification

required_content.workflow_revision_summary: string - executive summary of all workflow changes required

checkpoint_implementation.new_checkpoint_path: string - confirmed checkpoint path for retry
checkpoint_load_requirements: string - requirements for successful checkpoint loading
checkpoint_implementation.fallback_checkpoint: string - fallback checkpoint if primary fails

parameters_to_modify: string - list of parameters requiring modification
parameter_implementation.workflow_file_updates_required: boolean - whether workflow JSON requires updates

components_to_enable: string - list of identity components to enable/configure
identity_preservation_implementation.reference_image_requirements: string - reference image requirements from Workflow TD perspective

testing_requirements_before_retry: string - tests that should pass before retry authorization

retry_readiness_verdict.description: Explicit ready/not-ready verdict for retry planning from Workflow TD perspective

required_content.verdict_rationale: string - detailed rationale for readiness verdict
blocking_issues: string - list of any blocking issues preventing ready status
conditions_for_readiness: string - conditions that must be met if verdict is ready_with_conditions
required_content.character_director_dependency_status: string - status of Character Director completion dependency
required_content.estimated_implementation_time: string - estimated time to implement recommendations
required_content.confidence_level: enum: [high, medium, low] - confidence in retry success with current recommendations
required_content.technical_risk_level: enum: [low, medium, high] - technical risk assessment

joint_gate_dependency.description: Workflow TD completion must be submitted and validated before joint gate can clear. Both Character Director and Workflow TD completions required.
joint_gate_dependency.retry_authorized_by: joint validation of both role completion contracts
